title: ChatGPT Ads might be next big thing 👀
transcript: ChatGPT is giving me 50 bucks to run ads inside the chat, and I think this could be a massive opportunity for advertisers, so watch till the end. Now, ChatGPT can match ads with what you were talking about inside the chat. And no, that doesn't mean that ChatGPT is sharing your conversations. It's basically some fugazi fugazi algorithm that matches the right ad with the intent behind your conversation with the chat. And I think this is actually a new era of advertising because if you just think about it, people Google less and browse websites less. So, naturally, all of those ads from those places are slowly going to shift inside chatbots.

top_comments.author: @jonpool7902
top_comments.text: Except if you have any brain power you realize an ad is like air.  It exists and you do not need to do anything with it. Just ignore.   We don’t need more things. 😢
